EventAction_LuaScript.ScriptText:
-- Version: 4.2.0-stats --[[ 蓝方-01：区域随机生成发射车 + 周期控制（装填/机动/BOL） v4.2.0-stats: - LUCAS(4142) 发射计数：清理登记时累加（首架红方无人机入任务区起算） - 结束条件：未重创发射车≤END_SCAN_ALIVE_LE 才全量扫伤；全部≥END_DAMAGE 则 EndScenario - 挂架 Tick 节流 / STATIC 跳过 GetUnit（继承 perf） --]]
SCRIPT_VERSION = "4.2.0-stats" LAUNCHER_CTRL_VERSION = SCRIPT_VERSION
CONFIG = { UNIT_SIDE = "蓝方", RP_SIDE = "红方", REFERENCE_POINTS = { "RP-1", "RP-2", "RP-3", "RP-4" }, COUNT = 50, NAME_PREFIX = "发射车-", UNIT_TYPE = "Facility", UNIT_DBID = 3665, HEAVY_DAMAGE = 0.67, -- 想定结束：损伤阈值（可与查伤重创阈不同） END_DAMAGE = 0.70, -- 未重创发射车（内存计数）≤此值才开始全量扫伤验结束 END_SCAN_ALIVE_LE = 6, -- 或蓝方侧单元总数（含飞弹）≤此值也触发扫伤（用户举例门槛） END_SCAN_SIDE_UNITS_LE = 6, END_SCENARIO = true, RUN_SPAWN = true, MAX_RETRIES = 80, MIN_ELEV = 0, PHASE_MINUTES = { STATIC_1 = 3, FIRE = 4, STATIC_2 = 5, MOVE_1 = 15, MOVE_2 = 15, RELOAD = 8, }, TICK_INTERVAL = 3, MOVE_SPEED_KTS = 12, MOVE_DISTANCE_RATIO = 0.65, ARRIVE_NM = 0.05, MAX_BOL_PER_TICK = 5, TRIM_MOUNTS_AFTER_SPAWN = true, TRIM_MOUNTS_ON_TICK = true, TRIM_MOUNTS_INTERVAL_SEC = 300, DAMAGE_CHECK_MIN_INTERVAL_SEC = 10, EVENT_NAME = "蓝方-01-发射车周期", SCRIPT_FILE = "蓝方-01-发射车生成与周期.lua", RESET_ON_START = false, DEBUG = false, DEBUG_EVERY = 5, FIRE_WEAPON = { ENABLED = true, WEAPON_ID = 4142, MOUNT_ID = nil, BEARING_DEG = 280, AIMPOINT_NM = 80, QTY = 1, INTERVAL_SEC = 30, CLEANUP_ENABLED = true, CLEANUP_FLIGHT_MINUTES = 3, CLEANUP_UNIT_DBID = 4142, CLEANUP_NAME_PREFIX = nil, MASS_CLEANUP = false, }, }
LAUNCHER_CTRL_PHASES = { { id = "STATIC_1", key = "STATIC_1" }, { id = "FIRE", key = "FIRE" }, { id = "STATIC_2", key = "STATIC_2" }, { id = "MOVE_1", key = "MOVE_1" }, { id = "RELOAD", key = "RELOAD" }, { id = "MOVE_2", key = "MOVE_2" }, }
-- MEMORY：cars[name]={...}；stat=LUCAS 统计窗口 _LC = _LC or { cars = {}, names = nil, poly = nil, tick_n = 0, ready = false, wpn = {}, fire_ts = {}, mass_ts = 0, bol_budget = 0, stat = { t0 = nil, -- 首架红方无人机入任务区时刻 t1 = nil, -- 全部发射车达结束损伤时刻 launched = 0, -- 窗口内登记到的 LUCAS(4142) 数量 ended = false, ao_probe_i = 1, }, }
local function cfg() return CONFIG end local function fc() return CONFIG.FIRE_WEAPON end local function to_num(v) return tonumber(v) or 0 end local function ph_min(k) return cfg().PHASE_MINUTES[k] or 1 end local function ph_sec(k) return ph_min(k) * 60 end local function is_move(id) return id == "MOVE_1" or id == "MOVE_2" end local function reload_idx() for i, p in ipairs(LAUNCHER_CTRL_PHASES) do if p.id == "RELOAD" then return i end end return 5 end
local function car(name) local c = _LC.cars[name] if not c then c = { i = 0, t0 = 0, dlat = nil, dlon = nil, arr = false, hid = false, flast = 0, ko = false, guid = nil, snap = nil } _LC.cars[name] = c end return c end
local function pip(lat, lon, poly) local inside, j = false, #poly for i = 1, #poly do local yi, xi, yj, xj = poly[i].lat, poly[i].lon, poly[j].lat, poly[j].lon if ((yi > lat) ~= (yj > lat)) and (lon < (xj - xi) * (lat - yi) / ((yj - yi) + 1e-12) + xi) then inside = not inside end j = i end return inside end
local function bounds(poly) local a, b, c, d = poly[1].lat, poly[1].lat, poly[1].lon, poly[1].lon for i = 2, #poly do local p = poly[i] if p.lat < a then a = p.lat end; if p.lat > b then b = p.lat end if p.lon < c then c = p.lon end; if p.lon > d then d = p.lon end end return a, b, c, d end
local function load_poly(side, names, verbose) if #names < 3 then error("REFERENCE_POINTS 至少 3 个") end local poly, miss = {}, {} for _, n in ipairs(names) do local ok, rp = pcall(ScenEdit_GetReferencePoint, { side = side, name = n }) if ok and rp and rp.latitude then poly[#poly + 1] = { lat = to_num(rp.latitude), lon = to_num(rp.longitude), name = n } if verbose then print(string.format(" [RP@%s] %s → %.5f, %.5f", side, n, to_num(rp.latitude), to_num(rp.longitude))) end else miss[#miss + 1] = n end end if #miss > 0 then error("参考点未找到: " .. table.concat(miss, ", ")) end return poly end
local function rand_in_poly(poly, retries, min_elev) local a, b, c, d = bounds(poly) for _ = 1, retries do local lat = a + math.random() * (b - a) local lon = c + math.random() * (d - c) if pip(lat, lon, poly) then local elev = World_GetElevation({ latitude = lat, longitude = lon }) if elev and elev >= min_elev then return lat, lon end end end return nil, nil end
function Shared_LoadPolygon(force) if _LC.poly and not force then return _LC.poly end _LC.poly = load_poly(cfg().RP_SIDE, cfg().REFERENCE_POINTS, false) return _LC.poly end
function FacilitySpawn_Run() local c = cfg() math.randomseed(os.time()) print(string.format("=== [Spawn v%s] 随机生成 %d 设施 DBID=%d ===", SCRIPT_VERSION, c.COUNT, c.UNIT_DBID)) print(string.format("[INFO] 单元:%s | 参考点:%s | %s", c.UNIT_SIDE, c.RP_SIDE, table.concat(c.REFERENCE_POINTS, ", "))) local poly = load_poly(c.RP_SIDE, c.REFERENCE_POINTS, true) local ok_n, fail = 0, 0 for i = 1, c.COUNT do local lat, lon = rand_in_poly(poly, c.MAX_RETRIES, c.MIN_ELEV) local name = c.NAME_PREFIX .. i if lat then local ok, r = pcall(ScenEdit_AddUnit, { side = c.UNIT_SIDE, type = c.UNIT_TYPE, name = name, dbid = c.UNIT_DBID, latitude = lat, longitude = lon, heading = math.random(0, 359), }) if ok and r then ok_n = ok_n + 1; print(string.format("[OK] %s (%.5f, %.5f)", name, lat, lon)) else fail = fail + 1; print("[FAIL] " .. name .. " " .. tostring(r)) end else fail = fail + 1; print("[FAIL] " .. name .. " 无落点") end end print(string.format("=== 生成完成 成功%d/目标%d 失败%d ===", ok_n, c.COUNT, fail)) _LC.poly = poly if c.TRIM_MOUNTS_AFTER_SPAWN ~= false and type(LauncherCtrl_TrimMountsOnce) == "function" then LauncherCtrl_TrimMountsOnce() end return ok_n, fail end
-- 生成后一次性裁挂架（也可被识别事件节流调用） function LauncherCtrl_TrimMountsOnce() local side_name, prefix, keep = cfg().UNIT_SIDE, cfg().NAME_PREFIX, 1 local ok_side, side = pcall(VP_GetSide, { Side = side_name }) if not ok_side or not side or not side.units then print("[TrimMounts] 读不到阵营"); return 0 end local removed = 0 for _, ptr in ipairs(side.units) do local name = ptr.name or "" if name:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then local guid = ptr.guid or ptr.objectid for _ = 1, 6 do local ok, u = pcall(ScenEdit_GetUnit, { guid = guid }) if not (ok and u) then break end local mounts = u.mounts or u.Mounts if type(mounts) ~= "table" then break end local list = {} if mounts[1] ~= nil then for _, m in ipairs(mounts) do list[#list + 1] = m end else for _, m in pairs(mounts) do if type(m) == "table" then list[#list + 1] = m end end end if #list <= keep then break end local m = list[#list] local mid = m.mount_guid or m.guid local dbid = tonumber(m.mount_dbid or m.dbid or m.DBID) local ok_rm = false if mid then ok_rm = pcall(ScenEdit_UpdateUnit, { guid = guid, mode = "remove_mount", mountid = tostring(mid) }) end if not ok_rm and dbid then ok_rm = pcall(ScenEdit_UpdateUnit, { guid = guid, mode = "remove_mount", dbid = dbid }) end if not ok_rm then break end removed = removed + 1 end end end if removed > 0 then print(string.format("[TrimMounts] 裁挂架完成，共删 %d", removed)) end return removed end
--- 节流裁挂架：默认间隔 120s；识别事件可反复挂，不会每检测扫一遍 function LauncherCtrl_TrimMountsThrottled(interval_sec) interval_sec = tonumber(interval_sec) or 120 local kv = "lc_trim_last" local now = ScenEdit_CurrentTime() local last = tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv)) or 0 if last > 0 and (now - last) < interval_sec then return 0 end ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(kv, tostring(now)) return LauncherCtrl_TrimMountsOnce() end
-- 损伤 local function dmg_frac(u) if not u then return 0 end local cond = u.condition or u.Condition or u.status or u.Status if type(cond) == "string" then local s = cond:lower() if s:find("destroy", 1, true) or s:find("毁", 1, true) then return 1 end if s:find("heavy", 1, true) or s:find("重", 1, true) then return 0.75 end end local pct = tonumber(u.damagePercent or u.DamagePercent) if pct then return pct > 1 and math.min(1, pct / 100) or math.max(0, pct) end local d = u.damage or u.Damage if type(d) == "string" then local s = d:lower() if s:find("destroy", 1, true) or s:find("毁", 1, true) then return 1 end if s:find("heavy", 1, true) or s:find("重", 1, true) then return 0.75 end d = tonumber(d) end if type(d) == "number" then if d < 0 then return 0 end if d <= 1 then return d end if d <= 100 then return d / 100 end end return 0 end
local function freeze_ko(u, name) local st = car(name) if st.ko then return false end st.ko = true if u and u.guid then pcall(ScenEdit_SetUnit, { guid = u.guid, holdPosition = true, holdFire = true, throttle = "FullStop", speed = 0, }) end print(string.format("[LauncherCtrl] 重伤停摆 %s dmg=%.0f%%", name, dmg_frac(u) * 100)) return true end
local function get_u(name) -- 已知隐藏/停摆时不要 GetUnit：引擎即使被 pcall 也会刷异常日志，易触发熔断 local st0 = _LC.cars and _LC.cars[name] if st0 and (st0.hid or st0.ko) then return nil end if st0 and st0.guid then local okg, ug = pcall(ScenEdit_GetUnit, { guid = st0.guid }) if okg and ug then return ug end -- GUID 失效：按隐藏处理，勿再 name 查找 if st0 then st0.hid = true end return nil end local ok, u = pcall(ScenEdit_GetUnit, { side = cfg().UNIT_SIDE, unitname = name }) if ok and u then car(name).guid = u.guid return u end return nil end
local function hold(guid, fire) pcall(ScenEdit_SetUnit, { guid = guid, holdPosition = true, holdFire = fire, throttle = "FullStop" }) end
local function move_range(key) return cfg().MOVE_SPEED_KTS * (ph_min(key) / 60) * cfg().MOVE_DISTANCE_RATIO end
local function pick_wp(lat, lon, max_nm, poly) for _ = 1, 12 do local dist = max_nm * (0.35 + math.random() * 0.55) local ok, pt = pcall(World_GetPointFromBearing, { latitude = lat, longitude = lon, bearing = math.random() * 360, distance = dist, unit = "nm", }) if ok and pt then local la, lo = to_num(pt.latitude or pt.Latitude), to_num(pt.longitude or pt.Longitude) if pip(la, lo, poly) then local elev = World_GetElevation({ latitude = la, longitude = lo }) if elev and elev >= 0 then return la, lo end end end end return nil, nil end
local function begin_move(st, u, key, poly) local la, lo = pick_wp(to_num(u.latitude), to_num(u.longitude), move_range(key), poly) if not la then return false end st.dlat, st.dlon, st.arr = la, lo, false pcall(ScenEdit_SetUnit, { guid = u.guid, holdPosition = false, holdFire = true, speed = cfg().MOVE_SPEED_KTS, course = { { latitude = la, longitude = lo } }, }) return true end
local function save_snap(st, u) st.snap = { name = u.name, side = u.side or cfg().UNIT_SIDE, type = u.type or cfg().UNIT_TYPE, dbid = u.dbid or cfg().UNIT_DBID, latitude = to_num(u.latitude), longitude = to_num(u.longitude), heading = to_num(u.heading), } end
local function begin_reload(st, u) if st.ko then return end save_snap(st, u) st.hid, st.arr = true, false pcall(ScenEdit_DeleteUnit, { side = u.side or cfg().UNIT_SIDE, unitname = u.name }) end
local function respawn(name, st) if st.ko then st.hid = false; print("[LauncherCtrl] 装填结束不重建(重伤): " .. name); return nil end local s = st.snap if not s then return nil end local ok, u = pcall(ScenEdit_AddUnit, { side = s.side, type = s.type, name = s.name, dbid = s.dbid, latitude = s.latitude, longitude = s.longitude, heading = s.heading or 0, }) if ok and u then st.hid = false; st.guid = u.guid; return u end return nil end
local function bearing_pt(lat, lon, brg, nm) local ok, pt = pcall(World_GetPointFromBearing, { latitude = lat, longitude = lon, bearing = brg, distance = nm, unit = "nm", }) if ok and pt then return to_num(pt.latitude or pt.Latitude), to_num(pt.longitude or pt.Longitude) end return nil, nil end
local function note_fire(now) local keep = {} for _, ts in ipairs(_LC.fire_ts) do if (now - ts) <= 300 then keep[#keep + 1] = ts end end keep[#keep + 1] = now _LC.fire_ts = keep end
-- ---------- LUCAS 统计 / 想定结束 ---------- local function stat() if not _LC.stat then _LC.stat = { t0 = nil, t1 = nil, launched = 0, ended = false, ao_probe_i = 1 } end return _LC.stat end
--- 首架红方无人机进入任务区时调用（红方任务制 / 本侧兜底探测） function LauncherCtrl_NoteRedInAo(now) local s = stat() if s.t0 then return false end now = now or ScenEdit_CurrentTime() s.t0 = now ScenEdit_SetKeyValue("lc_lucas_t0", tostring(now)) print(string.format("[LucasStat] 统计起算：首架红方无人机入任务区 t0=%s", tostring(now))) return true end
local function count_alive_launchers() local names = LauncherCtrl_BuildNameList(false) local alive, ko_n = 0, 0 for _, name in ipairs(names) do local st = car(name) if st.ko then ko_n = ko_n + 1 else alive = alive + 1 end end return alive, ko_n, #names end
local function side_unit_count() local ok, side = pcall(VP_GetSide, { Side = cfg().UNIT_SIDE }) if not (ok and side and side.units) then return -1 end return #side.units end
--- 清理登记时：窗口内每发现一枚新的 4142 计 +1（不另开遍历） local function note_lucas_registered(name) local s = stat() if not s.t0 or s.ended then return end s.launched = (s.launched or 0) + 1 ScenEdit_SetKeyValue("lc_lucas_launched", tostring(s.launched)) if cfg().DEBUG then print(string.format("[LucasStat] +1 %s → 累计 %d", tostring(name), s.launched)) end end
function LauncherCtrl_LucasStatReport() local s = stat() local now = ScenEdit_CurrentTime() local dur = (s.t0 and ((s.t1 or now) - s.t0)) or 0 local alive, ko_n, total = count_alive_launchers() print("=== LucasStat ===") print(string.format("t0(入区)=%s | t1(结束)=%s | 历时=%.0fs", tostring(s.t0), tostring(s.t1), dur)) print(string.format("窗口内发射 LUCAS(Shahed-136/4142) 累计: %d", s.launched or 0)) print(string.format("发射车: 总数=%d 未重创=%d 已重创=%d | ended=%s", total, alive, ko_n, tostring(s.ended))) return s.launched or 0 end
local function finish_scenario(now, reason) local s = stat() if s.ended then return end s.ended = true s.t1 = now or ScenEdit_CurrentTime() ScenEdit_SetKeyValue("lc_lucas_t1", tostring(s.t1)) ScenEdit_SetKeyValue("lc_lucas_launched", tostring(s.launched or 0)) local dur = (s.t0 and (s.t1 - s.t0)) or 0 print("========== 想定结束 ==========") print(string.format("原因: %s", reason or "蓝方发射车全部达损伤阈值")) print(string.format("统计窗口: 首机入区 → 发射车全灭 | 历时 %.0f s", dur)) print(string.format("期间发射 LUCAS(Shahed-136) 总数: %d", s.launched or 0)) LauncherCtrl_LucasStatReport() if cfg().END_SCENARIO ~= false then local msg = string.format( "想定结束：发射车损伤达标。窗口内 LUCAS 发射 %d 枚，历时 %.0fs", s.launched or 0, dur) pcall(ScenEdit_SpecialMessage, cfg().UNIT_SIDE, msg) pcall(ScenEdit_SpecialMessage, cfg().RP_SIDE or "红方", msg) pcall(ScenEdit_EndScenario) end end
--- 仅在「未重创很少」或「侧单元很少」时才全量 GetUnit 验伤并可能结束 function LauncherCtrl_TryEndCheck(now) local s = stat() if s.ended then return false end now = now or ScenEdit_CurrentTime() local alive = select(1, count_alive_launchers()) local side_n = side_unit_count() local alive_le = cfg().END_SCAN_ALIVE_LE or 6 local side_le = cfg().END_SCAN_SIDE_UNITS_LE or 6 if alive > alive_le and not (side_n >= 0 and side_n <= side_le) then return false end
local thr = cfg().END_DAMAGE or 0.70 local names = LauncherCtrl_BuildNameList(false) local ok_all, checked = true, 0 for _, name in ipairs(names) do local st = car(name) if st.ko then checked = checked + 1 else local u = get_u(name) checked = checked + 1 if not u then ok_all = false -- 隐藏装填中：暂不判结束 else local d = dmg_frac(u) if d >= thr then if not st.ko then freeze_ko(u, name) end else ok_all = false end end end end if ok_all and #names > 0 and checked >= #names then if not s.t0 then s.t0 = now print("[LucasStat] 结束时尚未记到入区，t0 记为结束时刻") end finish_scenario(now, string.format("全部发射车损伤≥%.0f%%（扫 %d）", thr * 100, checked)) return true end return false end
--- 兜底：尚未起算时，从 dsw_drones 抽样看是否已有红机在任务区 local function probe_red_in_ao(now) local s = stat() if s.t0 then return end local poly = _LC.poly if not poly and type(LauncherCtrl_LoadPolygon) == "function" then poly = LauncherCtrl_LoadPolygon() end if not poly then return end local raw = "" pcall(function() raw = ScenEdit_GetKeyValue("dsw_drones") or "" end) if raw == "" then return end local guids = {} for g in string.gmatch(raw, "([^|]+)") do guids[#guids + 1] = g end if #guids == 0 then return end local i = s.ao_probe_i or 1 if i < 1 or i > #guids then i = 1 end local budget = 3 for k = 0, budget - 1 do local guid = guids[((i - 1 + k) % #guids) + 1] local ok, u = pcall(ScenEdit_GetUnit, { guid = guid }) if ok and u and pip(to_num(u.latitude), to_num(u.longitude), poly) then LauncherCtrl_NoteRedInAo(now) return end end s.ao_probe_i = ((i - 1 + budget) % #guids) + 1 end
local function try_bol(name, st, u, now) local f = fc() if not f.ENABLED then return false end if (_LC.bol_budget or 0) <= 0 then return false end if (now - (st.flast or 0)) < f.INTERVAL_SEC then return false end local al, ao = bearing_pt(to_num(u.latitude), to_num(u.longitude), f.BEARING_DEG, f.AIMPOINT_NM) if not al then return false end local opts = { mode = 1, weapon = f.WEAPON_ID, qty = f.QTY, latitude = al, longitude = ao } if f.MOUNT_ID then opts.mount = f.MOUNT_ID end local ok, r = pcall(ScenEdit_AttackContact, name, "BOL", opts) if ok and r then st.flast = now; note_fire(now) _LC.bol_budget = (_LC.bol_budget or 1) - 1 if cfg().DEBUG then print(string.format("[LauncherCtrl] %s BOL %d → %.0f°", name, f.WEAPON_ID, f.BEARING_DEG)) end return true end return false end
local function is_launcher(n) return n:sub(1, #cfg().NAME_PREFIX) == cfg().NAME_PREFIX end
local function ptr_cleanup(ptr) local f = fc() if not f.CLEANUP_ENABLED or not ptr then return false end local name = ptr.name or "" if name == "" or is_launcher(name) then return false end if f.CLEANUP_NAME_PREFIX and f.CLEANUP_NAME_PREFIX ~= "" then return name:sub(1, #f.CLEANUP_NAME_PREFIX) == f.CLEANUP_NAME_PREFIX end local dbid = tonumber(ptr.dbid or ptr.DBID) local want = f.CLEANUP_UNIT_DBID or f.WEAPON_ID if dbid then return dbid == want end local guid = ptr.guid or ptr.objectid if not guid then return false end local ok, u = pcall(ScenEdit_GetUnit, { guid = guid }) return ok and u and (u.dbid or 0) == want end
local function recent_fire(now, win) for _, ts in ipairs(_LC.fire_ts) do if (now - ts) <= win then return true end end return false end
local function est_spawn(now) local best = nil for _, ts in ipairs(_LC.fire_ts) do if ts <= now and (now - ts) <= 120 and (not best or ts > best) then best = ts end end return best or now end
function LauncherCtrl_CleanupWeaponUnits(now) local f = fc() if not f.CLEANUP_ENABLED then return 0 end now = now or ScenEdit_CurrentTime() local ttl = (f.CLEANUP_FLIGHT_MINUTES or 3) * 60 local reg = _LC.wpn local has_reg = next(reg) ~= nil local recently = recent_fire(now, ttl + 60) local mass_due = f.MASS_CLEANUP and (now - (_LC.mass_ts or 0)) >= ttl if not has_reg and not recently and not mass_due then return 0 end
if recently or mass_due then local side = VP_GetSide({ Side = cfg().UNIT_SIDE }) if side and side.units then for _, ptr in ipairs(side.units) do if ptr_cleanup(ptr) and ptr.name and not reg[ptr.name] then -- 新发现一枚在飞的 LUCAS：登记前计数（统计窗口内） note_lucas_registered(ptr.name) reg[ptr.name] = est_spawn(now) end end end end
local removed = 0 for name, ts in pairs(reg) do if (now - ts) >= ttl then pcall(ScenEdit_DeleteUnit, { side = cfg().UNIT_SIDE, unitname = name }) reg[name] = nil removed = removed + 1 end end if mass_due then _LC.mass_ts = now end return removed end
local function enter_phase(name, st, idx, poly, u) if st.ko then return end local phase = LAUNCHER_CTRL_PHASES[idx] st.arr = false if phase.id == "STATIC_1" or phase.id == "STATIC_2" then hold(u.guid, true) elseif phase.id == "FIRE" then hold(u.guid, false) elseif phase.id == "RELOAD" then begin_reload(st, u) elseif is_move(phase.id) then begin_move(st, u, phase.key, poly) end end
local function proc_hidden(name, st, now, poly) if st.i ~= reload_idx() then return false, nil end if st.ko then if (now - st.t0) >= ph_sec("RELOAD") then st.hid = false end return false, "KNOCKED" end if (now - st.t0) < ph_sec("RELOAD") then return false, "RELOAD_HIDDEN" end local ni = (st.i % #LAUNCHER_CTRL_PHASES) + 1 st.i, st.t0 = ni, now local u = respawn(name, st) if u then enter_phase(name, st, ni, poly, u); return true, LAUNCHER_CTRL_PHASES[ni].id end return false, "RELOAD_RESPAWN_FAIL" end
local function proc_visible(name, st, now, poly) if st.ko then return false, "KNOCKED" end local idx = st.i if idx < 1 or idx > #LAUNCHER_CTRL_PHASES then return false, nil end local phase = LAUNCHER_CTRL_PHASES[idx] local elapsed = now - st.t0 local need_unit = (elapsed >= ph_sec(phase.key)) or (phase.id == "FIRE") or (is_move(phase.id) and not st.arr and st.dlat) -- STATIC 未到期：零 GetUnit if not need_unit then return false, phase.id end

local function polygon_bounds(poly) local min_lat, max_lat = poly[1].lat, poly[1].lat local min_lon, max_lon = poly[1].lon, poly[1].lon for i = 2, #poly do local p = poly[i] if p.lat < min_lat then min_lat = p.lat end if p.lat > max_lat then max_lat = p.lat end if p.lon < min_lon then min_lon = p.lon end if p.lon > max_lon then max_lon = p.lon end end return min_lat, max_lat, min_lon, max_lon end

local function pick_zone_recon(label) local n = (cfg().RECON and cfg().RECON.ZONE_COUNT) or 5 if label == "雷达" then local cap = (cfg().RECON and cfg().RECON.RADAR_PER_ZONE) or 1 for z = 1, n do if (tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_z("r", z))) or 0) < cap then return z end end else local cap = (cfg().RECON and cfg().RECON.EO_PER_ZONE) or 5 for z = 1, n do if (tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_z("e", z))) or 0) < cap then return z end end end return 1 end
local function strike_cap(z) local caps = (cfg().STRIKE and cfg().STRIKE.ZONE_CAPS) or {} return caps[z] or 12 end
local function pick_zone_strike() local n = ((cfg().STRIKE and cfg().STRIKE.ZONE_ROWS) or 2) * ((cfg().STRIKE and cfg().STRIKE.ZONE_COLS) or 3) for z = 1, n do if (tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_z("s", z))) or 0) < strike_cap(z) then return z end end local best, best_n = 1, 1e9 for z = 1, n do local c = tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_z("s", z))) or 0 if c < best_n then best, best_n = z, c end end return best end
local function append_drone(guid) local raw = ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(KV_DRONES) or "" if raw:find(guid, 1, true) then return end ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(KV_DRONES, raw == "" and guid or (raw .. SEP .. guid)) end
local function register_drone(guid, name, label, zone_id) append_drone(guid) ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "name"), name) ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "role"), label) ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "zone"), tostring(zone_id)) if label == "雷达" then save_zone_count(zone_id, "r", (tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_z("r", zone_id))) or 0) + 1) elseif label == "光电" then save_zone_count(zone_id, "e", (tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_z("e", zone_id))) or 0) + 1) else save_zone_count(zone_id, "s", (tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_z("s", zone_id))) or 0) + 1) end end
local function mission_name_for(label, zone_id, phase) if RECON_LABELS[label] then return string.format(mcfg().RECON_MISSION_FMT, zone_id) end -- 对陆：进区阶段 → 进区巡逻；打击阶段 → 对地打击 if phase == "strike" then return string.format(mcfg().STRIKE_MISSION_FMT, zone_id) end return string.format(mcfg().INGRESS_MISSION_FMT, zone_id) end
local function assign_to_mission(guid, label, zone_id, phase) local mname = mission_name_for(label, zone_id, phase) local ok, res = pcall(ScenEdit_AssignUnitToMission, guid, mname) if not ok or not res then ok, res = pcall(ScenEdit_AssignUnitToMission, { guid = guid }, mname) end if ok and res ~= false then ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "mission"), mname) if label == STRIKE_LABEL then ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "phase"), phase or "ingress") end dbg(string.format("[MissionCtrl] 分派 %s → %s", guid, mname)) return true end print(string.format("[MissionCtrl] 分派失败 %s → %s | %s", tostring(guid), mname, tostring(res))) return false end
local function get_mother() local c = cfg() local ok, u = pcall(ScenEdit_GetUnit, { side = c.SIDE, unitname = c.MOTHER_UNIT }) if ok and u then return u end ok, u = pcall(ScenEdit_GetUnit, { side = c.SIDE, name = c.MOTHER_UNIT }) return ok and u or nil end
local function unit_name(label, serial, zone_id, local_idx) local code = (label == "雷达") and tostring(zone_id) or (tostring(zone_id) .. "-" .. tostring(local_idx)) return (cfg().NAME_PREFIX or "") .. label .. "-" .. serial .. "(" .. code .. ")" end
local function spawn_one(mother, item, qidx) local zone_id = RECON_LABELS[item.label] and pick_zone_recon(item.label) or pick_zone_strike() local local_idx = 1 if item.label == "雷达" then local_idx = 1 elseif item.label == "光电" then local_idx = (tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_z("e", zone_id))) or 0) + 1 else local_idx = (tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_z("s", zone_id))) or 0) + 1 end local serial = 0 local q = build_spawn_queue() for i = 1, qidx do if q[i].label == item.label then serial = serial + 1 end end local name = unit_name(item.label, serial, zone_id, local_idx)
local slat = to_num(mother.latitude) + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02 local slon = to_num(mother.longitude) + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02 local ok, res = pcall(ScenEdit_AddUnit, { side = cfg().SIDE, type = cfg().AIRCRAFT_TYPE, name = name, dbid = cfg().AIRCRAFT_DBID, loadoutid = item.loadoutid, latitude = slat, longitude = slon, altitude = cfg().SPAWN_ALT_M, heading = math.random(0, 359), }) if not ok or not res then print("[MissionCtrl] 创建失败: " .. name) return false end local guid = (type(res) == "table" and res.guid) or nil if not guid then local oku, u = pcall(ScenEdit_GetUnit, { side = cfg().SIDE, name = name }) if oku and u then guid = u.guid end end if not guid then return false end register_drone(guid, name, item.label, zone_id) local phase = RECON_LABELS[item.label] and nil or "ingress" assign_to_mission(guid, item.label, zone_id, phase) if phase == "ingress" then local spd = mcfg().INGRESS_SPEED_KTS or 180 pcall(ScenEdit_SetUnit, { guid = guid, speed = spd, holdPosition = false }) _MC.stats.spawn_t[guid] = ScenEdit_CurrentTime() ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "spawn_t"), tostring(_MC.stats.spawn_t[guid])) end print(string.format("[MissionCtrl] 释放 %d/%d %s → %s", qidx, #build_spawn_queue(), name, mission_name_for(item.label, zone_id, phase))) return true end
function MissionCtrl_SpawnTick() if ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(KV_READY) ~= "1" then MissionCtrl_Init() end if spawn_done() then return end local q = build_spawn_queue() local qidx = load_qidx() if qidx > #q then ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(KV_SPAWN_DONE, "1") print("[MissionCtrl] 全部释放完成") return end local now = ScenEdit_CurrentTime() local last = tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(KV_LAST_SPAWN)) or 0 if (now - last) < (cfg().SPAWN_INTERVAL_SEC or 5) then return end local mother = get_mother() if not mother then print("[MissionCtrl] 无母平台: " .. tostring(cfg().MOTHER_UNIT)) return end local item = q[qidx] save_qidx(qidx + 1) ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(KV_LAST_SPAWN, tostring(now)) if not spawn_one(mother, item, qidx) then save_qidx(qidx) end if qidx >= #q then ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(KV_SPAWN_DONE, "1") print("[MissionCtrl] 全部释放完成") end end
-- 把已存在但未分派的机补进任务 function MissionCtrl_AssignExisting() local raw = ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(KV_DRONES) or "" local n = 0 for guid in string.gmatch(raw, "([^|]+)") do local role = ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "role")) or "" local z = tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "zone"))) or 1 local phase = ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "phase")) if role == STRIKE_LABEL and (not phase or phase == "") then phase = "ingress" end if role ~= "" and (not ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "mission")) or ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "mission")) == "") then if assign_to_mission(guid, role, z, phase) then n = n + 1 end end end print(string.format("[MissionCtrl] 补分派 %d 架", n)) return n end
-- ---------- 进区判定 / 切打击 ---------- local function ao_center(poly) local a, b, c, d = polygon_bounds(poly) return (a + b) * 0.5, (c + d) * 0.5 end
local function range_nm(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) local ok, r = pcall(Tool_Range, { latitude = lat1, longitude = lon1 }, { latitude = lat2, longitude = lon2 }) return ok and r or 1e9 end
local function ready_near(lat, lon, poly) local clat, clon = ao_center(poly) local nm = mcfg().NEAR_NM or 35 return range_nm(lat, lon, clat, clon) <= nm end
local function ready_enter(lat, lon, poly) return point_in_polygon(lat, lon, poly) end
local function switch_to_strike(guid, zone_id, how) if assign_to_mission(guid, STRIKE_LABEL, zone_id, "strike") then _MC.stats.switched = (_MC.stats.switched or 0) + 1 ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "phase"), "strike") ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "switch_how"), how) if not mcfg().QUIET then print(string.format("[MissionCtrl] 进区完成→打击 区%d (%s) %s", zone_id, how, guid)) end return true end return false end
--- 对陆进区巡逻 → 打击任务；并记录 near/enter 哪个先满足（效率对比） function MissionCtrl_IngressTick() if ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(KV_READY) ~= "1" then return 0 end local poly = load_polygon() if not poly then return 0 end local raw = ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(KV_DRONES) or "" local guids = {} for guid in string.gmatch(raw, "([^|]+)") do if ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "role")) == STRIKE_LABEL and (ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "phase")) or "ingress") == "ingress" then guids[#guids + 1] = guid end end if #guids == 0 then return 0 end
local budget = mcfg().INGRESS_CHECK_BUDGET or 20 local cur = tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(KV_INGRESS_CUR)) or 1 if cur < 1 or cur > #guids then cur = 1 end local mode = mcfg().SWITCH_MODE or "near" local active = mcfg().ACTIVE_SWITCH or mode if mode == "compare" then active = mcfg().ACTIVE_SWITCH or "near" end local now = ScenEdit_CurrentTime() local switched = 0 local checked = 0
for i = 0, math.min(budget, #guids) - 1 do local idx = ((cur - 1 + i) % #guids) + 1 local guid = guids[idx] local ok, u = pcall(ScenEdit_GetUnit, { guid = guid }) _MC.stats.getu = (_MC.stats.getu or 0) + 1 checked = checked + 1 if ok and u then local lat, lon = to_num(u.latitude), to_num(u.longitude) local is_near = ready_near(lat, lon, poly) local is_enter = ready_enter(lat, lon, poly)
if is_near and not _MC.stats.near_t[guid] then _MC.stats.near_t[guid] = now if not _MC.stats.enter_t[guid] then _MC.stats.near_first_n = (_MC.stats.near_first_n or 0) + 1 end end if is_enter and not _MC.stats.enter_t[guid] then _MC.stats.enter_t[guid] = now if not _MC.stats.near_t[guid] then _MC.stats.enter_first_n = (_MC.stats.enter_first_n or 0) + 1 elseif _MC.stats.near_t[guid] == now then -- same tick both: count near as first end -- 统计起算：首架入任务区 if type(LauncherCtrl_NoteRedInAo) == "function" then pcall(LauncherCtrl_NoteRedInAo, now) end if type(AttritionCtrl_NoteEnter) == "function" then pcall(AttritionCtrl_NoteEnter, guid, now) end end
local do_switch = false local how = active if active == "near" then do_switch = is_near; how = "near" elseif active == "enter" then do_switch = is_enter; how = "enter" else do_switch = is_near; how = "near" end
if do_switch then local z = tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "zone"))) or 1 if switch_to_strike(guid, z, how) then switched = switched + 1 end end end end ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(KV_INGRESS_CUR, tostring(((cur - 1 + checked) % #guids) + 1)) if switched > 0 then print(string.format("[MissionCtrl] 本轮切打击 %d | 进区中 %d | 模式=%s/%s", switched, #guids, mode, active)) end return switched end
--- 打印 near vs enter 效率对比（可随时调用） function MissionCtrl_IngressCompareReport() local st = _MC.stats local near_dts, enter_dts, lead = {}, {}, {} for guid, nt in pairs(st.near_t or {}) do local sp = st.spawn_t[guid] or tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "spawn_t"))) if sp then near_dts[#near_dts + 1] = nt - sp end end for guid, et in pairs(st.enter_t or {}) do local sp = st.spawn_t[guid] or tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "spawn_t"))) if sp then enter_dts[#enter_dts + 1] = et - sp end end for guid, nt in pairs(st.near_t or {}) do local et = st.enter_t[guid] if et then lead[#lead + 1] = et - nt end -- enter 比 near 晚多少秒 end local function avg(t) if #t == 0 then return nil end local s = 0; for _, v in ipairs(t) do s = s + v end return s / #t end local an, ae, al = avg(near_dts), avg(enter_dts), avg(lead) print("=== Ingress 时机对比 (near vs enter) ===") print(string.format("NEAR_NM=%.0f | ACTIVE_SWITCH=%s | SWITCH_MODE=%s", mcfg().NEAR_NM or 35, tostring(mcfg().ACTIVE_SWITCH), tostring(mcfg().SWITCH_MODE))) print(string.format("已记 near就绪 %d | enter就绪 %d | 已切打击 %d | GetUnit累计 %d", #near_dts, #enter_dts, st.switched or 0, st.getu or 0)) print(string.format("释放→near均值 %s s | 释放→enter均值 %s s | enter晚于near均值 %s s", an and string.format("%.0f", an) or "-", ae and string.format("%.0f", ae) or "-", al and string.format("%.0f", al) or "-")) print(string.format("先满足 near 的机次 %d | 先满足 enter 的机次 %d", st.near_first_n or 0, st.enter_first_n or 0)) local rec = "near" if an and ae then -- 推荐：更早具备「可贴区作战」且 Lua 成本相同（同属 IngressTick） rec = (an <= ae) and "near（更早切打击，多出来的时间≈enter-near）" or "enter" end print("建议实际切换: " .. rec) print("说明: 两种判定共用同一 IngressTick/GetUnit 预算，Lua成本接近；差在切打击早晚与引擎接敌时机。") return { near_avg = an, enter_avg = ae, enter_lag = al, recommend = "near" } end
function MissionCtrl_SetSwitchMode(mode, active) -- mode: near|enter|compare ; active: near|enter（compare 时用） if mode then mcfg().SWITCH_MODE = mode end if active then mcfg().ACTIVE_SWITCH = active end print(string.format("[MissionCtrl] SWITCH_MODE=%s ACTIVE_SWITCH=%s NEAR_NM=%s", tostring(mcfg().SWITCH_MODE), tostring(mcfg().ACTIVE_SWITCH), tostring(mcfg().NEAR_NM))) end
-- ---------- 目标入打击任务 / 后期救场 ---------- local function contact_dbid(c) for _, k in ipairs({ "dbid", "DBID", "actualunitdbid", "ActualUnitDBID" }) do local v = tonumber(c[k]); if v and v > 0 then return v end end return nil end
local function is_strike_target(c) if not c then return false end local id = contact_dbid(c) for _, x in ipairs(mcfg().EXCLUDE_DBIDS or {}) do if id == x then return false end end local name = tostring(c.name or "") for _, kw in ipairs(mcfg().TARGET_KEYWORDS or {}) do if kw ~= "" and name:find(kw, 1, true) then return true end end for _, x in ipairs(mcfg().TARGET_DBIDS or {}) do if id == x then return true end end return false end
local function strike_zone_count() return ((cfg().STRIKE and cfg().STRIKE.ZONE_ROWS) or 2) * ((cfg().STRIKE and cfg().STRIKE.ZONE_COLS) or 3) end
--- 统计各区对陆机：strike 已切打击 / ingress 仍在进区 local function build_strike_roster() local strike_z, ingress_z = {}, {} local raw = ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(KV_DRONES) or "" for guid in string.gmatch(raw, "([^|]+)") do if ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "role")) == STRIKE_LABEL then local z = tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "zone"))) or 1 local ph = ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "phase")) or "ingress" local ok, u = pcall(ScenEdit_GetUnit, { guid = guid }) if ok and u then local row = { guid = guid, lat = to_num(u.latitude), lon = to_num(u.longitude) } if ph == "strike" then strike_z[z] = strike_z[z] or {} strike_z[z][#strike_z[z] + 1] = row else ingress_z[z] = ingress_z[z] or {} ingress_z[z][#ingress_z[z] + 1] = row end end end end return strike_z, ingress_z end
local function zone_center(z) local poly = load_polygon() if not poly then return 0, 0 end local a, b, c, d = strike_bounds(z, poly) return (a + b) * 0.5, (c + d) * 0.5 end
--- 已废弃：勿把目标挂到「有机区」——会与 ensure_shooters(借到本区) 对冲 local function pick_mission_zone(home_z, strike_z) return home_z end
local function count_roster(map) local n = 0 for _, list in pairs(map or {}) do n = n + #(list or {}) end return n end
local function force_switch_ingress(list, zone_id, how, limit) local n = 0 if not list then return 0 end for _, d in ipairs(list) do if limit and n >= limit then break end if switch_to_strike(d.guid, zone_id, how or "retask") then n = n + 1 end end return n end
--- 从其它区借打击/进区机到目标区打击任务 local function borrow_to_zone(need_z, strike_z, ingress_z, max_n) max_n = max_n or (mcfg().MAX_BORROW_PER_FEED or 4) local borrowed = 0 local tlat, tlon = zone_center(need_z) local cands = {} for z, list in pairs(strike_z) do if z ~= need_z then for _, d in ipairs(list) do cands[#cands + 1] = { guid = d.guid, from_z = z, phase = "strike", r = range_nm(d.lat, d.lon, tlat, tlon) } end end end for z, list in pairs(ingress_z) do if z ~= need_z then for _, d in ipairs(list) do cands[#cands + 1] = { guid = d.guid, from_z = z, phase = "ingress", r = range_nm(d.lat, d.lon, tlat, tlon) } end end end table.sort(cands, function(a, b) return a.r < b.r end) for _, c in ipairs(cands) do if borrowed >= max_n then break end -- 改挂到目标区打击任务，并改 zone KV（后续入目仍认新区） if assign_to_mission(c.guid, STRIKE_LABEL, need_z, "strike") then ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(kv_d(c.guid, "zone"), tostring(need_z)) ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(kv_d(c.guid, "phase"), "strike") ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(kv_d(c.guid, "borrow_from"), tostring(c.from_z)) borrowed = borrowed + 1 print(string.format("[MissionCtrl] 跨区借机 区%d→区%d %s (%s)", c.from_z, need_z, c.guid, c.phase)) end end return borrowed end
--- 保证 need_z 至少有打击机；有接触时本区进区机立刻切打击 local function ensure_shooters(need_z, strike_z, ingress_z) if mcfg().RETASK_ON_CONTACT == false then return 0, 0 end local switched, borrowed = 0, 0 local have = strike_z[need_z] and #strike_z[need_z] or 0 if have == 0 and ingress_z[need_z] and #ingress_z[need_z] > 0 then switched = force_switch_ingress(ingress_z[need_z], need_z, "contact", 8) strike_z, ingress_z = build_strike_roster() have = strike_z[need_z] and #strike_z[need_z] or 0 end if have == 0 and mcfg().BORROW_CROSS_ZONE ~= false then borrowed = borrow_to_zone(need_z, strike_z, ingress_z, mcfg().MAX_BORROW_PER_FEED or 4) end return switched, borrowed end
function MissionCtrl_FeedTargets() local side = mcfg().CONTACT_SIDE or mcfg().SIDE -- 入目要准：短 TTL 或强制刷新 if type(DroneSwarm_InvalidateContactCache) == "function" then pcall(DroneSwarm_InvalidateContactCache) end local list if type(DroneSwarm_GetContactsCached) == "function" then list = DroneSwarm_GetContactsCached(side, 5) else local ok, L = pcall(ScenEdit_GetContacts, side) list = (ok and L) or {} end
local strike_z, ingress_z = build_strike_roster() local added, refreshed, gone, matched = 0, 0, 0, 0 local seen, need_zones = {}, {}
for _, c in ipairs(list) do if is_strike_target(c) then matched = matched + 1 local g = c.guid or c.objectid if g then local key = tostring(g):gsub("-", ""):lower() seen[key] = true -- 目标固定挂接触所在区；打手调过去（勿挂「有机区」再反向借机） local home_z = MissionCtrl_StrikeZoneIdAt(to_num(c.latitude), to_num(c.longitude)) local mz = home_z local mname = string.format(mcfg().STRIKE_MISSION_FMT, mz) local prev = _MC.fed[key] need_zones[home_z] = true
-- 越区：从旧任务摘掉（失败忽略） if prev and prev ~= mz then local oldm = string.format(mcfg().STRIKE_MISSION_FMT, prev) pcall(ScenEdit_RemoveUnitAsTarget, g, oldm) pcall(ScenEdit_RemoveUnitAsTarget, { g }, oldm) end
local ok, res = pcall(ScenEdit_AssignUnitAsTarget, g, mname) if not ok or res == false then ok, res = pcall(ScenEdit_AssignUnitAsTarget, { g }, mname) end -- 名称兜底（有的接触用 name 更稳） if (not ok or res == false) and c.name then ok, res = pcall(ScenEdit_AssignUnitAsTarget, c.name, mname) end
if ok then if not prev then added = added + 1 if not mcfg().QUIET then print(string.format("[MissionCtrl] 目标入 %s: %s", mname, tostring(c.name))) end else refreshed = refreshed + 1 end _MC.fed[key] = mz end end end end
for key in pairs(_MC.fed) do if not seen[key] then _MC.fed[key] = nil gone = gone + 1 end end
local sw_n, br_n = 0, 0
-- 有发射车接触但全区无打击机：进区机全员切打击，避免「看见却没人打」 if matched > 0 and count_roster(strike_z) == 0 and mcfg().FORCE_ALL_INGRESS_IF_NO_STRIKE ~= false and mcfg().RETASK_ON_CONTACT ~= false then for z, ilist in pairs(ingress_z) do sw_n = sw_n + force_switch_ingress(ilist, z, "all-ingress", 99) end if sw_n > 0 then strike_z, ingress_z = build_strike_roster() end end
for z, _ in pairs(need_zones) do local a, b = ensure_shooters(z, strike_z, ingress_z) sw_n, br_n = sw_n + a, br_n + b if a > 0 or b > 0 then strike_z, ingress_z = build_strike_roster() end end
if added > 0 or sw_n > 0 or br_n > 0 or matched > 0 or not mcfg().QUIET then print(string.format( "[MissionCtrl] 入目 +%d 刷新 %d 消失 %d | 强切打击 %d 跨区借 %d | 目标接触 %d/%d", added, refreshed, gone, sw_n, br_n, matched, #list)) end return added end
-- UnitDetected 轻量入口 function MissionCtrl_OnDetected() return MissionCtrl_FeedTargets() end
-- ---------- 光电补装（轻量，可选） ---------- function MissionCtrl_EoSensorTick() local dbid = cfg().EO_SENSOR_DBID if not dbid then return end local raw = ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(KV_DRONES) or "" local n, budget = 0, cfg().EO_SENSOR_PER_TICK or 5 for guid in string.gmatch(raw, "([^|]+)") do if n >= budget then break end if ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "role")) == "光电" and ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "eo_sens")) ~= "1" then local ok = pcall(ScenEdit_UpdateUnit, { guid = guid, mode = "add_sensor", dbid = dbid, }) if ok then ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "eo_sens"), "1") n = n + 1 end end end end

local KV_DRONES = "dsw_drones" local KV_AC_T0 = "ac_t0" local KV_AC_LAST = "ac_last_slice" local SEP = "|"
local function acfg() return ATTRITION_CTRL_CONFIG end
local function kv_d(guid, key) return "dsw_" .. tostring(guid) .. "_" .. key end
local function to_num(v) return tonumber(v) or 0 end
local function point_in_polygon(lat, lon, poly) if not poly or #poly < 3 then return false end local inside = false local j = #poly for i = 1, #poly do local xi, yi = poly[i][1], poly[i][2] local xj, yj = poly[j][1], poly[j][2] if ((yi > lat) ~= (yj > lat)) and (lon < (xj - xi) * (lat - yi) / ((yj - yi) + 1e-15) + xi) then inside = not inside end j = i end return inside end
local function load_polygon() local side = acfg().SIDE or "红方" local names = { "RP-1", "RP-2", "RP-3", "RP-4" } if DRONE_SPAWN_CONFIG and DRONE_SPAWN_CONFIG.REFERENCE_POINTS then names = DRONE_SPAWN_CONFIG.REFERENCE_POINTS end local poly = {} for _, nm in ipairs(names) do local ok, rp = pcall(ScenEdit_GetReferencePoint, { side = side, name = nm }) if not (ok and rp) then ok, rp = pcall(ScenEdit_GetReferencePoint, { side = DRONE_SPAWN_CONFIG and DRONE_SPAWN_CONFIG.RP_SIDE or side, name = nm }) end if ok and rp then poly[#poly + 1] = { to_num(rp.latitude), to_num(rp.longitude) } end end if #poly < 3 then return nil end return poly end
local function role_of(guid) local r = ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(kv_d(guid, "role")) if r and r ~= "" then return r end local ok, u = pcall(ScenEdit_GetUnit, { guid = guid }) if ok and u and u.name then local n = tostring(u.name) if n:find("雷达", 1, true) then return "雷达" end if n:find("光电", 1, true) then return "光电" end if n:find("对陆", 1, true) then return "对陆" end end return "other" end
local function p_for(role) local t = acfg().P_KILL or {} return tonumber(t[role]) or tonumber(t.other) or 0 end
local function remove_unit(guid, role) local method = acfg().METHOD or "kill" local ok = false if method == "delete" then ok = pcall(ScenEdit_DeleteUnit, { guid = guid }) else ok = pcall(ScenEdit_KillUnit, { guid = guid }) if not ok then ok = pcall(ScenEdit_DeleteUnit, { guid = guid }) end end if ok then local bucket = (_AC.killed[role] ~= nil) and role or "other" _AC.killed[bucket] = (_AC.killed[bucket] or 0) + 1 end return ok end

--- 外部可调：首机入区时调用（MissionCtrl Ingress 已有钩子时可接） function AttritionCtrl_NoteEnter(guid, now) now = now or ScenEdit_CurrentTime() if guid and not _AC.enter_t[guid] then _AC.enter_t[guid] = now end if not _AC.t0 then _AC.t0 = now ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(KV_AC_T0, tostring(now)) if not acfg().QUIET then print(string.format("[AttritionCtrl] 起算 t0=%s（首机入区）", tostring(now))) end end end

function AttritionCtrl_Tick() if acfg().ENABLED == false then return 0 end local now = ScenEdit_CurrentTime() ensure_t0(now) local poly = load_polygon() if not poly then return 0 end
local raw = ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(KV_DRONES) or "" local candidates = {} for guid in string.gmatch(raw, "([^|]+)") do local ok, u = pcall(ScenEdit_GetUnit, { guid = guid }) if ok and u then local lat, lon = to_num(u.latitude), to_num(u.longitude) local in_ao = point_in_polygon(lat, lon, poly) if in_ao then if not _AC.enter_t[guid] then AttritionCtrl_NoteEnter(guid, now) end if not acfg().ONLY_IN_AO or in_ao then candidates[#candidates + 1] = guid end end end end
if not _AC.t0 then return 0 end
local last = _AC.last_slice or tonumber(ScenEdit_GetKeyValue(KV_AC_LAST)) or _AC.t0 local slice = tonumber(acfg().SLICE_SEC) or 60 if (now - last) < slice then return 0 end
-- 可能积压多段：按时间推进，每段最多 MAX local killed_total = 0 local guard = 0 while (now - last) >= slice and guard < 20 do guard = guard + 1 last = last + slice _AC.slice_i = (_AC.slice_i or 0) + 1 _AC.attempts = (_AC.attempts or 0) + 1
-- 刷新存活候选（上一段可能已删） candidates = {} for guid in string.gmatch(raw, "([^|]+)") do local ok, u = pcall(ScenEdit_GetUnit, { guid = guid }) if ok and u then local lat, lon = to_num(u.latitude), to_num(u.longitude) if point_in_polygon(lat, lon, poly) and _AC.enter_t[guid] then candidates[#candidates + 1] = guid end end end -- 打乱顺序，避免总删列表前面的 for i = #candidates, 2, -1 do local j = math.random(i) candidates[i], candidates[j] = candidates[j], candidates[i] end

_AC.last_slice = last ScenEdit_SetKeyValue(KV_AC_LAST, tostring(last)) return killed_total end
